headline: Broad market maintains an expansionary bias driven by Industrials, Discretionary, and Health Care, while select Financials and IT software segments continue to lag.
breadth_commentary: Underlying market breadth remains net positive across the 880-stock universe, with 962 issues in expansion versus 615 in drawdown and minimal compression (2). Health Care (18.7% bull vs 6.2% bear expansion) and Consumer Discretionary (12.2% bull vs 6.4% bear) show strong constructive displacement breadth, whereas Utilities (3.3% bull vs 10.2% bear) and Financials (5.5% bull vs 6.9% bear) reflect weaker participation.
sector_leadership: Industrials and IT Services are exhibiting strong leadership, with IT Consulting & Other Services (RRG 98.6, +42.08% 4w momentum) and Cables - Electricals (RRG 97.6) hitting 52-week highs. Sub-sector conviction is heavily concentrated in Telecom Infrastructure (77.6% conviction, top stock HFCL.NS), Industrial Products (75.4%, RAYMOND.NS), and Pharmaceuticals (74.7%, SHILPAMED.NS), alongside strong momentum in Private Sector Banks (77.58%).
sector_laggards: Capital is rotating out of capital markets and niche lending, with Investment Banking & Brokerage (-14.08% 4w mom), Microfinance Institutions (-12.17%), and Stockbroking (-8.78%) lagging heavily in RRG scoring. Software Products (RRG 24.2, -10.04% 4w mom) and Footwear (RRG 25.8) are also displaying sustained relative weakness.
notable_setups: Top PM conviction names are led by explosive momentum setups in SJS.NS (0.884), INDIGOPNTS.NS (0.882), and RAYMOND.NS (0.852), alongside steady accumulation in EXIDEIND.NS. New campaign breakouts sustaining high scores above previous drawdown highs include THELEELA.NS (3.77% DD mag, 10 weeks above DDH) and TEXINFRA.NS (5.81% DD mag). Upside displacement strength is prominent in RBA.NS (Z-score +4.40) and MOREPENLAB.NS (+4.04), while downside displacement flags sharp pressure in TEMBO.NS (-4.09) and RHETAN.NS (-3.36).
levels_to_watch: Key structural 52-week ceiling breakouts were triggered to the upside by TI.BO (displacement Z: 3.81) and GALAXYSURF.NS (Z: 3.46). Conversely, structural 52-week floor breakdowns occurred in RHETAN.NS, GODREJCP.NS, KPEL.BO, and MVKAGRO.NS, warranting caution on downside continuation.
